::: {#sol-linear-param-grad}

Entry $j$ of the output is $z_j = \sum_k W_{jk} h_k + b_j$,
so $W_{jk}$ affects $\loss$ only through $z_j$.

$$
\begin{aligned}
\derivf{\loss}{W_{jk}}
&= \derivf{\loss}{z_j} \derivf{z_j}{W_{jk}}
&& \text{(chain rule through $z_j$)} \\
&= \backerr_j h_k
&& \text{(since $\derivf{z_j}{W_{jk}} = h_k$)}
\end{aligned}
$$

As a matrix,

$$
\gradwrt{\matr{W}} \loss = \oprod{\vbackerr}{\vhidval},
$$

an $m \times n$ outer product for a layer with $n$ inputs and $m$ outputs,
with the same [shape](pytorch-basics.qmd#def-shape) as $\matr{W}$.

:::
